title: INZOI Contest Upload Issues
content:
Hello Clo-Set!  
I can't upload my work for the contest because it gives an error when uploading ZPRJ file. The number of polygons of clothing does not exceed 40,000 (my clothes 29300). I also uploaded an avatar in A pose without animation as indicated in the guide.   
I think maybe the problem is in the number of polygons in the avatar? Its number is 87K polygons  
I attached a screenshot of error. How can I fix this problem?  
UPD: I try to upload without avatar the same problem  
  
Thank you  
![42c1dfeb111e4e2eb0c8a01f3cfee887](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/eac5b4177d0449e4a0b4ce3e8fec16b8/images/42c1dfeb111e4e2eb0c8a01f3cfee887photo_2025-07-16_23-34-26.jpg)  



### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hey, I am having the same issue! My project has 18142 polygons and 36046 triangles and I got the same error as you. How did you solve it?
Reply 1: Hello! I optimized my project to less than 30,000 triangles. It helped.

Comment 2: Thank you so much for your help! This was the reason! I corrected the number of triangles and was able to upload the work❤️Many thanks!
Reply 1: ❤️

Comment 3: Got it ! Thanks
Reply 1: I noticed that you adjusted the model to have 40,000 polygons.However, the limit should be 40,000 triangles, not polygons.

Comment 4: Hi, victoriascostumesThe inZOI contest uses the triangle count in Thickness Mode as the standard.Does your outfit have 40,000 triangles or fewer in Thickness Mode?
Reply 1: Hello, RobinYes, that's right. Its 29300 polygons in Thickness Mode
Reply 2: Hi, victoriascostumesCan you send us the project file through the Help Center below?We will provide technical support as quickly as possible.https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/eac5b4177d0449e4a0b4ce3e8fec16b8
content_description: This webpage aims to provide troubleshooting assistance for users experiencing upload errors related to ZPRJ files in the Clo-Set contest.
